proposals.action_title: Launch 1st Niche Coloring Book on KDP using Runware PAYG
proposals.why_this_works_now: KDP is registered but has 0 listings. Using Runware PAYG (~1.20 EUR for 200 high-quality FLUX-schnell images) bypasses the GitHub Actions API blockages and delivers professional-grade coloring lines that organic Amazon traffic actually buys.
proposals.first_action_today: Fund Runware account with 5 EUR, run the 'produce_coloring_book' script with Runware API key to generate 40 French countryside illustrations.

proposals.action_title: Bulk Upload 100 Minimalist French Quote Stickers
proposals.why_this_works_now: Redbubble is registered but empty. Text-based stickers require 0 image generator API calls, bypass all AI generation issues, and rank fast for trending French micro-quotes with high margins on stickers.
proposals.first_action_today: Write a 20-line Python script in Termux using PIL (Pillow) to generate 100 transparent PNG text stickers using free Google Fonts.

proposals.action_title: Publish 3 Parametric 3D Printing Organizers using OpenSCAD
proposals.why_this_works_now: Cults3D buyers actively pay 1-3 EUR for functional, modular grid organizers. By generating STL variations via OpenSCAD on GitHub Actions, you can target specific desk/drawer dimensions without needing a physical 3D printer.
proposals.first_action_today: Create a basic OpenSCAD script for a modular drawer divider, commit it to GitHub, and use GHA to export 5 common size configurations.

proposals.why_this_works_now: Low-content logbooks (carnets de suivi) require no complex AI image generation except for the cover. Interior layouts are simple PDF grids easily generated via Python/ReportLab in Termux.
proposals.first_action_today: Generate a 100-page 'Carnet de suivi Ruche/Apiculture' interior PDF using Python on Termux.

proposals.action_title: Launch itch.io Gamedev UI Asset Pack (Pay-What-You-Want)
proposals.why_this_works_now: The gamedev community on itch.io frequently tips creators for clean UI assets. Using Pollinations (which is functional) to generate dark-fantasy or sci-fi UI button elements requires zero budget and can be packaged into a ZIP instantly.
proposals.first_action_today: Set up a free itch.io creator profile and run a quick Pollinations script to fetch 50 fantasy-themed UI icons.
